name: FEMA HSEEP
description: U.S. Homeland Security Exercise and Evaluation Program (HSEEP) — the national standard framework for designing, conducting, and evaluating emergency management exercises. Used by federal, state, local, tribal, and territorial governments across all hazard types. Provides standardized methodology for discussion-based and operations-based exercises.
domain: emergency management, homeland security, all-hazards preparedness
difficulty_level: variable (scales from local to national level)
reputation: authoritative national standard; mandated for US federal preparedness grant recipients
notes: Free government publication. Defines exercise types: seminar, workshop, drill, game, tabletop exercise, functional exercise, full-scale exercise. Widely adopted internationally.
